title: Saturating Subtractor
statement: Implement an 8-bit saturating subtractor that clamps the signed result at -128 or +127 on overflow. The subtractor should compute a - b and saturate the result when the signed difference exceeds representable bounds. This prevents wraparound in arithmetic datapaths.
module_signature: module saturating_subtractor(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, output reg signed [7:0] y);
behavior: y = a - b unless signed overflow occurs.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use behavioral constructs that ignore signed overflow semantics.
hint: Detect signed overflow by comparing operand signs and result signs.
